## Conventions checklist
- [ ] Agents use `model: inherit`, a `color`, a trigger-style description, and a "When to invoke" section
- [ ] User-invoked skills declare `allowed-tools` and a third-person trigger description
- [ ] No personal data, telemetry, hooks, MCP servers, or third-party integrations
- [ ] Tests or a smoke scenario that show the main flow working
